answers.explanation: A streak of failures (and of successes to come back) smooths out noise.
It reacts between probes and catches servers that pass /healthz but fail real requests.
A partial outage becomes total. Health checks should mostly report whether this process can serve.
Do it before removing a backend for a deploy.
A cold server handed a full share can fall over.
Every check ends in a timeout, which can't distinguish dead, slow, or unreachable. Every health check is a guess.
